title: The Wisdom of Our Mothers (የእናቶቻችን ጥበብ)
creative_note: A fictional, emotionally grounded Ethiopian short film about a mother (Almaz) and her young son (Dawit) in the Ethiopian highlands. Narrated in Amharic with English subtitles, it weaves four timeless lessons—trusting God, respecting others, never giving up, and holding onto hope in difficult times—into warm everyday moments of prayer, hospitality, study, and weather passing into sunlight.

lessons.lesson_en: Remain hopeful, even during difficult times

scenes.title: Dawn Prayer and Morning Light
scenes.purpose: Establish the Ethiopian highland setting, dawn atmosphere, and the mother's quiet morning presence.
scenes.visual: At dawn in an Ethiopian highland home courtyard, soft golden mist drifts over green hills. Through an open wooden doorway, Almaz, an Ethiopian mother in a white woven netela, tends a glowing clay jebena hearth as warm morning light fills the room.
scenes.image_prompt: Wide establishing shot of a peaceful Ethiopian highland courtyard at dawn, soft morning mist over distant green hills, warm golden light spilling from an open doorway where a fictional Ethiopian mother in her early 40s wearing a white cotton netela with subtle tibeb border tends a traditional clay jebena coffee pot over warm embers, cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, warm ochre and ivory tones, center-framed composition, no text.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera push-in toward the sunlit doorway, soft morning mist drifting outside, subtle steam rising from the jebena, calm natural motion.
scenes.narration: ገና ፀሐይ ሳትወጣ፣ የእናቴን ጸሎትና የጠዋት ድምፅ እሰማ ነበር።
scenes.subtitle_en:
Before sunrise, I would hear
my mother's quiet morning prayer.
scenes.audio: Soft dawn room tone and distant birdsong; gentle plucked krar-inspired notes begin quietly.

scenes.title: Trust God

scenes.camera_movement: Slow static hold with subtle breath of motion
scenes.visual: Inside the warm earthen-walled room, morning sunbeams fall across Almaz and her 9-year-old son Dawit sitting side by side on low wooden stools. Almaz rests a gentle hand near his shoulder as they bow their heads in quiet prayer.
scenes.image_prompt: Medium shot inside a warm traditional Ethiopian home, golden morning sunbeams from a wooden window illuminating a fictional Ethiopian mother in her early 40s in a white netela and her 9-year-old son in a cream shirt and navy sweater sitting side by side on low wooden stools, heads gently bowed in quiet prayer, peaceful affectionate expression, centered framing, cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, no text.
scenes.motion_prompt: Locked-off gentle camera with subtle dust motes drifting in the sunbeam, mother and child breathing calmly and lifting their heads slowly with serene warmth.
scenes.narration: «ልጄ፣ መንገዱ ሲከብድህ በእግዚአብሔር ታመን፤ እርሱ አይተውህም» ትለኝ ነበር።
scenes.subtitle_en:
"When the road grows heavy, trust in God;
He will never leave you."
scenes.audio: Warm underscore ducks gently beneath Amharic narration; soft felt piano supports the krar motif.

scenes.title: Peace in Faith
scenes.purpose: Reinforce the first lesson visually through a close, intimate detail of maternal care and steady faith.
scenes.camera_movement: Gentle tilt up from hands to faces
scenes.visual: A warm close-up of Almaz's steady hands adjusting the collar of Dawit's sweater and resting reassuringly on his shoulder before he heads out, her face calm with quiet faith.
scenes.image_prompt: Warm close-up of a fictional Ethiopian mother's gentle hands adjusting her 9-year-old son's navy knit sweater collar by morning window light, both faces softly illuminated with calm faith and tenderness, shallow depth of field, centered framing, cinematic realism, 35mm film look, no text.
scenes.motion_prompt: Gentle slow camera tilt upward from the mother's hands to her calm reassuring smile, natural soft fabric movement in warm morning light.
scenes.narration: በጸሎቷ ውስጥ የማይናወጥ ሰላምና በፈጣሪ ላይ ሙሉ እምነት አይ ነበር።
scenes.subtitle_en:
In her prayers, I saw unshakable peace
and complete faith in the Creator.
scenes.audio: Soft cloth rustle under sustained warm strings and gentle piano notes.

scenes.title: Respect Every Person
scenes.purpose: Present the second lesson—respecting other people—in an everyday Ethiopian community interaction.
scenes.visual: Along an earthen neighborhood path lined with eucalyptus trees in warm morning light, Almaz greets an elderly neighbor with a respectful slight bow and guides Dawit to help carry the elder's woven basket.
scenes.image_prompt: Medium wide shot on an sunlit earthen village path with eucalyptus trees in Ethiopia, a fictional Ethiopian mother in a white netela bowing slightly with warm respect while greeting an elderly neighbor, guiding her 9-year-old son in a navy sweater to politely help hold a woven basket, warm natural daylight, centered framing, cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, no text.
scenes.motion_prompt: Gentle slow tracking camera alongside the path, the mother nodding warmly and the boy stepping forward respectfully to take the basket handle, soft leaves swaying.
scenes.narration: «ሰውን ሁሉ አክብር፤ ክብር የሰው ልጅ ውበት ነው» ብላ አስተምራኛለች።
scenes.subtitle_en:
"Respect every person;

scenes.audio: Light outdoor footsteps and gentle breeze; warm washint flute tone enters softly beneath narration.

scenes.purpose: Deepen the second lesson by showing humility and hospitality around the family mesob.
scenes.visual: Around a colorful woven mesob table, Almaz gracefully serves warm injera to the elderly neighbor and Dawit first, modeling humility and care for both elders and the young.
scenes.image_prompt: Warm medium shot inside an Ethiopian dining corner around a traditional woven mesob table, a fictional Ethiopian mother in a white netela gently serving injera with warm hospitality to an elderly guest and her 9-year-old son, soft golden indoor light, rich earthy colors, centered framing, cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, no text.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in toward the mesob table as the mother serves food with calm grace and exchanges a warm smile with the elder and child.
scenes.narration: ለታላቅም ለታናሽም በትሕትና ቦታ መስጠትን ከተግባሯ ተማርኩ።
scenes.subtitle_en:
From her deeds, I learned humility
and respect for both elders and the young.
scenes.audio: Subtle warm table ambience and soft acoustic guitar/krar arpeggios under clear narration.

scenes.title: Never Give Up

scenes.visual: At a worn wooden table in late afternoon light, Dawit stares discouraged at an open school notebook after erasing a mistake. Almaz sits beside him, placing her hand steadily over his to encourage him to keep trying.
scenes.image_prompt: Medium close-up at a wooden table lit by warm late afternoon window light, a fictional 9-year-old Ethiopian boy looking discouraged over an open school notebook and pencil, his Ethiopian mother in her early 40s leaning close beside him with a steady, encouraging hand on his arm, warm empathetic expression, centered framing, cinematic realism, 35mm film look, no text.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow steady push-in as the boy sighs and looks down, then lifts his eyes as his mother gently places her hand beside his notebook and nods encouragingly.
scenes.narration: «ብትወድቅም ተነሳ እንጂ፣ ፈጽሞ እጅ አትስጥ፤ ጥረትህን ቀጥል» ትል ነበር።
scenes.subtitle_en:
"Even if you fall, rise again—never give up;

scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of a fictional 9-year-old Ethiopian boy gripping a pencil with quiet determination as he writes carefully in a notebook on a wooden desk, his mother softly out of focus in the warm background watching proudly, golden afternoon rim light, centered framing, cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, no text.

scenes.narration: በትዕግሥቷ፣ መሸነፍ ሳይሆን እንደገና መሞከር ጥንካሬ እንደሆነ አወቅሁ።
scenes.subtitle_en:
Through her patience, I learned strength means

scenes.title: Hope in the Storm
scenes.purpose: Deliver the fourth lesson—remaining hopeful even during difficult times—contrasting a dark storm with inner warmth.
scenes.visual: During a heavy highland rainstorm, cool blue-grey rain falls outside the open doorway. Inside, lit by a warm glowing hearth, Almaz wraps her cotton netela around Dawit's shoulders and points calmly toward a sliver of light at the horizon.
scenes.image_prompt: Medium shot inside an Ethiopian home doorway during a heavy highland rainstorm, cool slate-blue rain visible outside while warm orange hearth light illuminates a fictional Ethiopian mother wrapping her white cotton netela around her 9-year-old son, mother gently pointing toward a faint break in the dark clouds on the horizon, emotional warmth amidst hardship, centered framing, cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, no text.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow gentle pull-back while rain falls steadily outside the doorway, warm firelight flickering softly on their faces as the mother holds her son close.

scenes.subtitle_en:
"Even in the darkest storm, tomorrow brings light;

scenes.visual: After the rain, bright golden sunbeams break through parting clouds over lush wet highland hills. Almaz and Dawit walk hand in hand along the glistening path, looking ahead with quiet hope.

Even in the hardest times,
